notes.title: Aggressor update
notes.content:
The latest update for Roidrekt has added new player pickups in the form of laser drones and time-stretching faster-than-light travel. As well as a raft of performance improvements, the game's difficulty has been tweaked.

The ante has been upped with the inlcusion of boss battles. Test your combat prowess against the new alien Mothership boss, featuring laser barrages and homing missile assaults. 

A captured UFO craft has also been added to the player ship selection, unlocking after achieving a score of 40,000 or more.
